newsitem.title: USA: Sears buys MaxServ shares, completes merger.
newsitem.headline: Sears buys MaxServ shares, completes merger.

text.p: Sears, Roebuck and Co said Wednesday it has acquired at a price of $7.75 a share all shares of common stock of MaxServ Inc not previously tendered.
The Sears/MaxServ merger became effective on March 18. MaxServ is now a wholly owned subsidiary of Sears, the company said.
Holders of MaxServ shares who did not tender will receive information from MaxServ giving the procedures to either exercise appraisal rights or receive $7.75 a share.
On Monday, Sears said it completed a $7.75-a-share tender offer, under which about 3.7 million shares were tendered. Prior to the tender offer, it owned 7.03 million shares of the company.
Sears operates retail stores and provides auto repair and home improvement services.
MaxServ provides information services for Sears customers. Sears had been a customer of MaxServ since 1983 and accounted for more than 93 percent of MaxServ's revenues.
